roadmap_unit: A3 C5' target consolidation on C5-F1
claim_under_pricing: Re-confirm the handling-limit structural-ceiling prize on the curvature-compensated C5-F1 family with fresh seed streams before any C5' RL training. The priced prize is oracle - per-instance grid-tuned reflex on T-limit rows. This is zero training and can only prepare a PI CP-1 decision; it cannot admit Track C by itself.

seed_discipline.disjointness: new seed base disjoint from C5 S0-S3 pricing base 20260712, A1 lateral rider base 20260812, and A2 normalization base 20260813; selection and validation eval-seed sets are asserted disjoint at runtime.

T_limit.track: circle R=60 m, width 5 m, curvature-compensated C5-F1 obstacle placement
T_limit.admission: same as C5: generator label in {aeb_feasible, aes_feasible} AND per-instance adjusted label in {aeb, aes, drift}; oracle filtering is reported but structural gap uses unfiltered paired oracle-vs-pertuned rows

arms.fixed_v4_incumbent: M3105 v4 reflex verbatim; secondary transfer arm
arms.fixed_star: one fixed 27-grid config selected on pooled S0/T-limit selection rows
arms.v4_rls: 5 s sub-limit kappa_b/kappa_d familiarization prefix and frozen kappa map, reported as classical context but not the primary C5' floor
arms.v4_pertuned: per (level, T_limit, instance) winner of the 27-point grid on selection rows; primary reflex-family floor
arms.oracle: same reveal-constrained privileged search as C5: fixed_star closed-loop prefix to reveal, 15 structured candidates, then CEM with early stop

tuning_grid_27.selection_tiebreak: higher selection success, then fewer hard failures, then fewer multipliers different from 1, then lower grid index

preregistered_readouts.primary_structural_gap_per_cell: p(oracle_solved) - p(v4_pertuned_success) on unfiltered paired validation rows
preregistered_readouts.secondary_gap_vs_fixed_star: p(oracle_solved) - p(fixed_star_success) on unfiltered paired validation rows
preregistered_readouts.uncertainty: episode-paired bootstrap CI95 for structural gaps; Wilson CIs per arm already reported by the C5 runner
preregistered_readouts.decision_rule: C5' target is confirmed iff >=3 of 4 T-limit target cells have oracle_minus_pertuned >= 0.15 with paired-bootstrap CI95 lower bound > 0. Confirmation only prepares CP-1; it does not admit Track C training without PI sign-off.

runtime_gates: composed v2+v4 action function must equal the canonical M3105 v4 function exactly on 200 random observations
selection and validation eval-seed sets disjoint
light rollout outcome must match run_episode_with_policy outcome on sampled rows
RLS prefix peak rear utilization must stay below 0.6
budget_and_trim_rule: Full A3 panel is 4 levels x 12 instances x 6 selection rows x 27 grid configs plus 4 levels x 12 instances x 12 validation rows x four scripted arms and oracle. If projected wall time exceeds 2.5 h, trim S3 from 12 to 8 instances; never trim validation rows per retained instance.
known_blockers_and_limits: M3221 found obs-normalization/preview blockers for population or high-speed training; A3 is zero-training pricing and does not implement those changes.
A3 is current-sim C5-F1 only; Chrono multi-vehicle D1 remains separate.
CP-1 PI approval is required after A3 before any Track C training.
claim_boundary: C5' target-consolidation pricing measurement only. Zero training. No incumbent driver mutation, driver-performance, validation ranking, promotion, high-fidelity sufficiency, paper, repair-success, robustness-result, feasibility-proof, or self-ID claim.
